questions.question: Lok Sabha passed the Waqf (Amendment) Bill 2025. Which concept does the Waqf (Amendment) Bill, 2024 remove?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Waqf by user**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Lok Sabha Passes Waqf (Amendment) Bill 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Amendment Purpose:** The Bill amends the Waqf Act of 1995 to improve the management and transparency of Waqf properties in India.

 
 
• 
 
**Removal of "Waqf by User":** Properties continuously used as Waqf (e.g., mosques) now require official documentation (Waqfnama) to be recognized as Waqf.

 
 
• 
 
**Survey of Properties:** The District Collector or other senior officers will now oversee the survey of Waqf properties, replacing the Survey Commissioner.

 
 
• 
 
**Non-Muslim Representation:** Non-Muslim Chief Executive Officers and members may now be appointed to state-level Waqf Boards.

 
 
• 
 
**Limitation Act (1963):** The Bill makes the Limitation Act applicable to Waqf properties, allowing claims of unlawful possession after 12 years.

 
 
• 
 
**Section 107 Deleted:** The deletion allows the Limitation Act to apply to Waqf properties, enabling claims of adverse possession.

 
 
• 
 
**Government’s Rationale:** The amendments are aimed at addressing loopholes such as title disputes and illegal occupations of Waqf properties.

 
 
• 
 
**Transparency Measures:** The Bill mandates a unified digital listing of Waqf properties to reduce litigation and improve transparency.

 
 
• 
 
**Criticism:** Opposition argues the Bill gives the government too much power over Waqf properties, potentially undermining Muslim community rights.

 
 
• 
 
**Disputed Properties:** The government (through the District Collector) will treat disputed Waqf properties as government property until resolved.

questions.question: What does the acronym "PAIR" stand for in the context of the Union Government's research initiative?

options.text: Partnerships for Accelerated Innovation and Research
Professional Academia for Innovation and Research

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Partnerships for Accelerated Innovation and Research**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The PAIR programme stands for "Partnerships for Accelerated Innovation and Research" and aims to enhance research excellence in Indian universities.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The PAIR programme aims to stimulate innovation in emerging institutions by leveraging mentorship from high-ranking institutions.**
 
• **It focuses on improving research quality and establishing collaborative networks.**
 
• The programme is aligned with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 and aims to bridge the gap between emerging and established institutions.
 
• PAIR will work on a hub and spoke model where top-tier institutions (hubs) will guide smaller, emerging institutions (spokes) to improve their research ecosystem.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **The programme's approach__ **

 __
 
• The initiative employs a "hub and spoke" model, pairing emerging universities (spokes) with established institutions (hubs) for mentorship and resource sharing. 
 
• Each PAIR network would consist of 1 hub and up to 7 spoke institutions.
 
• Hub institutions will include the top 25 NIRF ranking institutions and Institutions of National Importance.
 
• The aim is to create networks that drive internationally competitive research.
 
 ** **
 
• **The role of mentorship__ **
 
 
• Mentorship will elevate overall research standards in emerging institutions.
 
• It ensures access to advanced infrastructure and best practices in research.

questions.question: Which organization is responsible for organizing the ‘Panchayat Se Parliament 2.0’ program?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**National Commission for Women**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 'Panchayat Se Parliament 2.0' program is organized by the **National Commission for Women (NCW)**.
 
• The program aims to **empower women** at the grassroots level and enhance their participation in politics.
 
• It seeks to **bridge the gap** between local governance (Panchayats) and the central legislative process (Parliament).
 
• The initiative includes **training sessions, workshops, and interactive discussions** to develop leadership skills among women.
 
• The program targets women representatives from **Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs)** and aims to create a pipeline of women leaders for higher political roles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Commission for Women (NCW)**

 
 
• Established in January 1992 under the **National Commission for Women Act, 1990**.
 
• The NCW is a statutory body responsible for **reviewing legal and constitutional safeguards for women**.
 
• It aims to **advise the government** on policy matters affecting women and ensure their protection and welfare.
 
• The commission conducts **research, workshops, and awareness programs** to promote gender equality and combat discrimination against women.
 
 
 
• **Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs)**
 
 
• PRIs are a system of rural local governance in India, established by the **73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992**.
 
• They consist of three tiers: **Gram Panchayat (village level), Panchayat Samiti (block level), and Zilla Parishad (district level)**.
 
• PRIs aim to **decentralize power and empower rural communities** by involving them in decision-making processes.
 
• They play a crucial role in **implementing development programs** and ensuring the effective delivery of public services at the grassroots level.
 
 
 
• **Women Empowerment in Politics**
 
 
• Programs like 'Panchayat Se Parliament 2.0' aim to **increase the representation of women** in political and decision-making bodies.
 
• Empowering women in politics helps to address **gender disparities** and ensure that women’s issues and perspectives are considered in policy-making.
 
• It contributes to **inclusive governance** and promotes sustainable development by leveraging the potential of women leaders.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Eklavya Platform:

1.The Eklavya Platform was launched by the Ministry of Minority Affairs.

2.The theme for 2024 is the "Year of Technology Absorption."

3. The platform has been developed through Bhaskaracharya National Institute of Space Applications and Geoinformatics (BISAG-N).

How many of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__

questions.question: In 2025, which bill received Presidential assent to become law, aiming to reform and modernize the governance of Waqf properties in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Waqf (Amendment) Bill, 2025.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

• **President Droupadi Murmu gave her assent to the Waqf (Amendment) Bill, 2025, officially making it a law aimed at reforming waqf property management across India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The Waqf (Amendment) Bill, 2025 was passed by the Lok Sabha with 288 votes in favour and by the Rajya Sabha with 128 votes.
 
• Following Parliamentary approval, it received Presidential assent and became law.
 
• The law introduces key reforms in the governance, transparency, and efficiency of waqf property administration in India.
 
• It seeks to address issues like litigation and lack of judicial oversight in waqf-related matters.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 __

questions.question: Parliament passes Oilfields Amendment Bill 2024. What term replaces "mining leases" under the new Bill?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Petroleum leases**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Parliament passes Oilfields Amendment Bill 2024. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The **Oilfields (Regulation and Development) Amendment Bill, 2024** seeks to amend the **Oilfields (Regulation and Development) Act, 1948**.
 
• The **definition of mineral oils** is broadened to include **naturally occurring hydrocarbons**, **coal bed methane**, and **shale gas/oil**.
 
• **Coal**, **lignite**, and **helium** are **excluded** from the definition of mineral oils as they are regulated under the **Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act, 1957**.
 
• The term **“mining leases”** is replaced by **“petroleum leases”** for exploration, production, and disposal of mineral oils.
 
• **Existing mining leases** under the Oilfields Act of 1948 remain **valid** and will not be altered.
 
• The Bill **increases financial penalties** for violations, with the **maximum fine set at Rs 25 lakh** and additional daily fines of **Rs 10 lakh** for ongoing violations.
 
• The Bill aims to **encourage private investment** in petroleum production and ensures that existing leases are not disadvantaged.
 
• The **central government retains rule-making powers** to regulate various aspects of petroleum lease grants, conservation, and development of mineral oils.
 
• The Bill expands the **central government’s authority** over issues like **merger of petroleum leases**, **sharing of facilities**, and **environmental obligations**.
 
• The **Adjudicating Authority** for penalties will be an **officer of Joint Secretary rank** or higher.
 
• **Appeals against decisions** of the Adjudicating Authority will be made to the **Appellate Tribunal for Electricity**, as per the **PNGRB Act, 2006**.

questions.question: What is the minimum monthly pension provided by the Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan (PM-SYM) scheme after the age of 60?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**₹3,000**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan (PM-SYM), is a voluntary and contributory pension scheme launched by the Government of India to provide social security to unorganised workers. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan (PM-SYM)** is a **voluntary** and **contributory pension scheme** launched by the Government of India for **unorganised workers**.
 
• The scheme guarantees a **minimum monthly pension of ₹3,000** after the age of **60** for workers earning **up to ₹15,000** per month.
 
• **PM-SYM** was introduced in the **Interim Budget 2019**.
 
• It is administered by the **Ministry of Labour and Employment**, in collaboration with **Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC)** and **Common Service Centres (CSCs)**.
 
• **LIC** is responsible for **pension pay-outs** and acts as the **Pension Fund Manager**.
 
• **Enrolment** in the scheme is facilitated through **Common Service Centres (CSCs)** across India.
 
• **Exit and Withdrawal Provisions:**
 
 
• **Exit Before 10 Years:** Refund of the contributed amount with **savings bank interest rate**.
 
• **Exit After 10 Years but Before 60 Years:** Return of contributions with **accumulated interest** (either actual or savings bank interest rate, whichever is higher).
 
• **Death Before 60 Years:** The **spouse** can either continue the scheme or withdraw the contributed amount with interest.
 
• **Death After 60 Years:** The **spouse** receives **50%** of the pension as a family pension.
 
• After the death of both the subscriber and spouse, the **entire corpus is credited back to the fund**.
 
• **In case of default** (non-payment of contributions): The subscriber can **regularize their contribution** by paying the outstanding dues and **penalty charges**, if any.

questions.question: Which technology is being leveraged for precise drain mapping along the Ganga main stem under the Namami Gange Mission?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Drone and LiDAR Technology.**__

__
 
• **Drone and LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) technology enables high-resolution mapping of drainage systems along the Ganga.**
 
• **These tools help identify pollution sources and monitor wastewater discharge with precision.**
 
• **The data-driven approach ensures targeted interventions for river conservation and pollution control.**
 
• **The initiative aligns with the government’s goal of using advanced technology to rejuvenate the Ganga.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• LiDAR Technology__

 __
 
• LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) uses laser pulses to measure distances and create detailed 3D maps.
 
• It is highly effective for identifying terrain features, mapping water bodies, and assessing environmental changes.
 
 
 
• Namami Gange Mission__
 __
 
• A flagship program aimed at cleaning and rejuvenating the Ganga River.
 
• It includes projects on sewage treatment, riverfront development, wetland conservation, and pollution control.
 
 
 
• Environmental Flow (e-Flow) Compliance__
 
 
• Ensures regulated water discharge from Devprayag to Haridwar and up to Unnao in Uttar Pradesh.
 
• Aims to maintain the ecological balance of the river system and improve water quality.

questions.question: The Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana was launched on which date?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**22nd January 2015.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Over four crore Sukanya Samriddhi accounts have been opened across India under the scheme.**
 
• The Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana was launched on 22nd January 2015 as part of the Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao campaign.
 
• It allows parents to open an account for girls at post offices or designated commercial bank branches.
 
• 22nd January 2025 marks ten years since the scheme's launch.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana was launched on 22nd January 2015 to promote savings for the education and marriage of girl children.**
 
• It is a small savings scheme under the Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao initiative aimed at empowering the girl child.
 
• Parents or legal guardians can open accounts for girls below the age of 10 years.
 
• The scheme provides tax benefits under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act and offers attractive interest rates.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)__

 __
 
• The scheme allows deposits of up to ₹1.5 lakh annually with attractive interest rates and maturity benefits.
 
• The account matures after 21 years or upon the marriage of the girl, whichever is earlier.
 
• The scheme is instrumental in supporting the education and future of girls across the country.
 
 
 
• Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao Campaign__
 
 
• Launched in 2015, this initiative aims to address declining child sex ratios and promote the welfare of girls.
 
• It focuses on education, health, and financial independence of the girl child.

questions.question: Which initiative has been introduced to ensure uniform data representation and improve data clarity across various public datasets in India?

options.text: National Data Sharing and Accessibility Policy (NDSAP)

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**National Metadata Structure (NMDS 2.0).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation introduced NMDS 2.0 to ensure uniform data representation across public datasets.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• NMDS 2.0 provides uniformity in data representation and clarity on data sources and collection methods.
 
• It enhances the discoverability and understanding of datasets, including census, surveys, and administrative records.
 
• The framework has been shared with various Ministries/Departments for implementation.
 
• The Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation actively coordinates with Statistical Advisors for its execution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Data Sharing and Accessibility Policy (NDSAP)**__:

 __
 
• Launched in 2012 to promote data sharing and accessibility for research and innovation.
 
• Aims to improve transparency and open government data.
 
 
 
• **Digital India Metadata Framework (DIMF)**__:
 __
 
• A proposed framework to standardize metadata for various digital assets.
 
• Designed for interoperability across government databases.
 
 
 
• **Open Government Data (OGD) Initiative**__:
 
 
• Facilitates data-driven decision-making by making government datasets publicly available.
 
• Managed under the Digital India initiative.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Operation Greens Scheme:

1. Operation Greens is a centrally sponsored scheme launched under the Pradhan Mantri Kisan SAMPADA Yojana.

2. The scheme focuses exclusively on Tomato, Onion, and Potato (TOP) crops, as they are perishable in nature.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Neither 1 nor 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The Parliamentary Standing Committee on Agriculture, Animal Husbandry, and Food Processing has highlighted the underperformance of the Operation Greens Scheme.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Operation Greens is a central sector scheme, not a centrally sponsored scheme**, launched in 2018 under the Pradhan Mantri Kisan SAMPADA Yojana. ***Hence, statement 1 is incorrect.***
 
• While the scheme initially focused on Tomato, Onion, and Potato (TOP) crops, **its scope was expanded under the 15th Finance Commission cycle (2021-26)** to include 22 perishable crops, such as fruits, vegetables, garlic, ginger, and shrimp. ***Hence, statement 2 is incorrect.***
